_note: Original exercise descriptions written for B.A.B. Bodyweight only. Versioned with the code.

exercises.name: Wall push-up
exercises.instructions: Stand an arm's length from a wall, hands at chest height. Bend your elbows to bring your chest toward the wall, then press back.

exercises.name: Incline push-up
exercises.instructions: Hands on a sturdy table or bench, body in a straight line. Lower your chest to the edge and push away.

exercises.name: Knee push-up
exercises.instructions: From your knees with hands under your shoulders, keep hips in line with your back and lower your chest to the floor.

exercises.name: Chair dip
exercises.instructions: Hands on the front edge of a stable chair, feet on the floor with knees bent. Lower until elbows reach about 90 degrees, then press up.

exercises.name: Push-up
exercises.instructions: Hands slightly wider than shoulders, body straight from head to heels. Lower until your chest is just above the floor, then press up.

exercises.name: Wide push-up
exercises.instructions: Place your hands wider than a normal push-up and keep elbows soft. Lower under control and press back up.

exercises.name: Pike push-up
exercises.instructions: Hips high so your body makes an upside-down V. Bend your elbows to bring the top of your head toward the floor, then push back.

exercises.name: Feet-raised chair dip
exercises.instructions: Like a chair dip but with legs straight and heels on a second chair. Lower slowly and press up without shrugging.

exercises.name: Close-hand push-up
exercises.instructions: Hands close together under your chest so thumbs and fingers nearly touch. Keep elbows tucked as you lower and press.

exercises.name: Decline push-up
exercises.instructions: Feet on a step or bench, hands on the floor. Keep your body rigid and lower your chest toward the floor.

exercises.name: Dive push-up
exercises.instructions: Start in a high V. Swoop your chest forward close to the floor and up into a gentle back arch, then reverse the path.

exercises.name: Feet-raised pike push-up
exercises.instructions: Feet on a bench with hips stacked high over your hands. Lower your head toward the floor and press back up.

exercises.name: Archer push-up
exercises.instructions: Hands very wide. Lower toward one hand while the other arm stays nearly straight, then switch sides each rep.

exercises.name: Lean-forward push-up
exercises.instructions: Turn your fingers slightly out and lean your shoulders well past your hands. Keep that lean as you lower and press.

exercises.name: Wall handstand lower
exercises.instructions: Kick up to a handstand facing away from a wall. Lower your head toward the floor as slowly as you can, then come down safely.

exercises.name: Lying Y-T-W raise
exercises.instructions: Lie face down, arms overhead. Lift your arms into a Y, then a T, then a W, squeezing your shoulder blades each time. That is one rep.

exercises.name: Lying pull-down
exercises.instructions: Lie face down with arms overhead and chest slightly lifted. Pull your elbows down to your ribs as if pulling a bar, then reach back out.

exercises.name: Reverse snow angel
exercises.instructions: Face down with chest lifted a little. Sweep straight arms from your hips to overhead and back without touching the floor.

exercises.name: Door towel row
exercises.instructions: Loop a towel around both handles of a closed, locked door. Lean back holding the ends and row your chest toward the door.

exercises.name: Table row
exercises.instructions: Lie under a sturdy table, grip the edge, body straight. Pull your chest up to the edge and lower slowly.

exercises.name: One-arm door towel row
exercises.instructions: Same as the door towel row, holding the towel with one hand. Keep hips square and switch arms each set.

exercises.name: Feet-raised table row
exercises.instructions: Table row with your heels on a chair so your body is level. Pull your chest to the table edge.

exercises.name: Archer table row
exercises.instructions: Grip the table edge with hands wide. Row toward one hand while the other arm stays straight, alternating sides.

exercises.name: Dead hang
exercises.instructions: Hang from the bar with straight arms and a firm grip. Breathe steadily and keep your shoulders active.

exercises.name: Shoulder-blade pull-up
exercises.instructions: From a hang, pull your shoulder blades down and together so your body rises a little, without bending your elbows.

exercises.name: Slow pull-up lower
exercises.instructions: Jump or step up so your chin is over the bar. Lower yourself as slowly as you can to a full hang.

exercises.name: Chin-up
exercises.instructions: Palms facing you, shoulder-width grip. Pull until your chin passes the bar, then lower under control.

exercises.name: Pull-up
exercises.instructions: Palms facing away, slightly wider than shoulders. Pull your chest toward the bar and lower all the way down.

exercises.name: Archer pull-up
exercises.instructions: Wide grip. Pull toward one hand while the other arm straightens along the bar, alternating sides.

exercises.name: Chair sit-to-stand
exercises.instructions: Sit on the front of a chair, feet flat. Stand up without using your hands, then sit back down slowly.

exercises.name: Glute bridge
exercises.instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent. Drive through your heels to lift your hips until your body is straight from knees to shoulders.

exercises.name: Calf raise
exercises.instructions: Stand tall near a wall for balance. Rise onto the balls of your feet, pause, and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Bodyweight squat
exercises.instructions: Feet shoulder-width apart. Sit your hips back and down until thighs are about level with the floor, then stand.

exercises.name: Reverse lunge
exercises.instructions: Step one foot back and lower until both knees bend to about 90 degrees. Push through the front foot to return. Alternate legs.

exercises.name: Wall sit
exercises.instructions: Back flat against a wall, slide down until knees are bent to about 90 degrees. Hold with weight in your heels.

exercises.name: Step-up
exercises.instructions: Step onto a sturdy step or low bench with one foot and stand fully. Step down with control. Alternate legs.

exercises.name: Single-leg calf raise
exercises.instructions: Balance on one foot near a wall. Rise as high as you can, then lower slowly. Switch legs each set.

exercises.name: Split squat
exercises.instructions: One foot forward, one back, in a long stance. Lower the back knee toward the floor and rise, keeping your torso upright.

exercises.name: Single-leg glute bridge
exercises.instructions: Glute bridge with one foot on the floor and the other leg lifted. Keep your hips level as you lift and lower.

exercises.name: Walking lunge
exercises.instructions: Lunge forward, then bring the back foot through into the next lunge. Keep each step controlled.

exercises.name: Rear-foot-raised split squat
exercises.instructions: Back foot resting on a chair behind you. Lower straight down until the front thigh is about level, then drive up.

exercises.name: Jump squat
exercises.instructions: Squat down, then jump straight up. Land softly with bent knees and go straight into the next rep.

exercises.name: Assisted one-leg squat
exercises.instructions: Hold a door frame. Squat down on one leg with the other leg held forward, using your hands only as needed.

exercises.name: Shrimp squat
exercises.instructions: Stand on one leg holding the other foot behind you. Lower until the back knee touches the floor, then stand.

exercises.name: One-leg squat
exercises.instructions: Balance on one leg with the other straight in front. Squat all the way down and stand back up without help.

exercises.name: Knee plank
exercises.instructions: On forearms and knees, keep a straight line from head to knees. Squeeze your stomach and breathe.

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.instructions: On your back, arms up and knees over hips. Lower the opposite arm and leg toward the floor while your lower back stays down. Alternate.

exercises.name: Bird dog
exercises.instructions: On hands and knees, reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back. Hold briefly and switch sides.

exercises.name: Forearm plank
exercises.instructions: On forearms and toes, body straight. Brace your stomach and avoid letting your hips sag or pike.

exercises.name: Reverse crunch
exercises.instructions: On your back with knees bent up. Curl your hips off the floor toward your chest, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Bicycle crunch
exercises.instructions: On your back, hands lightly by your head. Bring one elbow toward the opposite knee while the other leg extends. Alternate.

exercises.name: Side plank
exercises.instructions: On one forearm with feet stacked, lift your hips into a straight line. Hold, then switch sides on the next set.

exercises.name: Hollow hold
exercises.instructions: On your back, press your lower back down and lift shoulders and legs a little off the floor. Hold the shape.

exercises.name: Plank shoulder tap
exercises.instructions: In a high plank with feet apart, tap one shoulder with the opposite hand without rocking your hips. Alternate.

exercises.name: Lying leg raise
exercises.instructions: On your back with legs straight. Raise your legs to vertical and lower them slowly, keeping your lower back down.

exercises.name: Hanging knee raise
exercises.instructions: Hang from the bar. Lift your knees toward your chest without swinging, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: V-up
exercises.instructions: From lying flat, lift straight legs and arms together to meet above your hips, then lower with control.

exercises.name: Hollow rock
exercises.instructions: Hold the hollow position and rock gently from shoulders to hips without losing the shape.

exercises.name: L-sit hold
exercises.instructions: Hands on two sturdy chairs or the floor. Press down to lift your hips and hold your legs straight out in front.

exercises.name: Hanging leg raise
exercises.instructions: Hang from the bar and raise straight legs until they are level or higher. Lower slowly without swinging.

exercises.name: Marching in place
exercises.instructions: March on the spot, lifting knees and swinging your arms. Keep a steady, brisk rhythm.

exercises.name: Step jack
exercises.instructions: Step one foot out to the side as your arms rise overhead, then bring it back. Alternate sides without jumping.

exercises.name: Shadow boxing
exercises.instructions: Light on your feet, throw quick straight punches and hooks into the air. Keep your guard up between punches.

exercises.name: Jumping jack
exercises.instructions: Jump your feet apart while raising your arms overhead, then jump back together. Land softly.

exercises.name: High knees
exercises.instructions: Run on the spot, driving your knees to hip height and pumping your arms.

exercises.name: Mountain climber
exercises.instructions: From a high plank, drive your knees toward your chest one after the other at a quick pace.

exercises.name: Skater hop
exercises.instructions: Hop sideways from one foot to the other, landing softly and swinging your arms across.

exercises.name: Squat thrust
exercises.instructions: Squat, place hands on the floor, step or jump feet back to a plank, then return and stand.

exercises.name: Fast feet
exercises.instructions: In a slight squat, patter your feet as quickly as you can on the balls of your feet.

exercises.name: Burpee
exercises.instructions: Squat, jump your feet back to a plank, do a push-up, jump your feet in, then jump up with arms overhead.

exercises.name: Tuck jump
exercises.instructions: Jump up and pull your knees toward your chest. Land softly and reset before the next jump.

warmup.name: Arm circles
warmup.instructions: Arms out to the sides. Make small circles that grow larger, then reverse.

warmup.name: Hip circles
warmup.instructions: Hands on hips, feet apart. Draw big slow circles with your hips in both directions.

warmup.name: Leg swings
warmup.instructions: Hold a wall. Swing one leg forward and back, then side to side. Switch legs halfway.

warmup.name: Brisk march
warmup.instructions: March on the spot or around the room, swinging your arms.

warmup.name: Inchworm walk-out
warmup.instructions: From standing, walk your hands out to a plank and back, then stand up tall.

warmup.name: Cat and cow
warmup.instructions: On hands and knees, round your back up, then let it dip while lifting your chest.

cooldown.name: Child's pose
cooldown.instructions: Knees wide, sit back toward your heels and reach your arms forward. Breathe slowly.

cooldown.name: Hamstring stretch
cooldown.instructions: Sit with one leg straight. Hinge forward from the hips toward that foot. Switch halfway.

cooldown.name: Standing quad stretch
cooldown.instructions: Hold a wall and pull one heel toward your seat. Keep knees together. Switch halfway.

cooldown.name: Doorway chest stretch
cooldown.instructions: Forearms on a door frame, step gently through until you feel a stretch across your chest.

cooldown.name: Slow breathing
cooldown.instructions: Lie or sit comfortably. Breathe in for four counts and out for six.

easy_day.name: March in place
easy_day.instructions: Lift your knees to a comfortable height and swing your arms. Breathe easy.

easy_day.name: Chair squats
easy_day.instructions: Sit down to a chair and stand up again, slowly. Rest when you need to.

easy_day.name: Wall push-ups
easy_day.instructions: Hands on a wall at shoulder height. Bend your elbows to bring your chest close, then push away.

easy_day.name: Glute bridges
easy_day.instructions: Lie on your back, knees bent. Lift your hips, squeeze, and lower slowly.

easy_day.name: Easy walk
easy_day.instructions: Walk around your room, corridor or outside at a relaxed pace.

easy_day.name: Stretch and breathe
easy_day.instructions: Reach up tall, fold forward gently, then take five slow breaths.
